projects.name: AI Travel Agent
projects.description: A tool-calling travel agent on the Anthropic API that searches flights and hotels, checks weather and builds day-by-day itineraries. It runs as a CLI chat or a FastAPI endpoint with multi-turn conversations.
highlights: Each turn is capped at 8 model calls and a 60-second deadline, and the agent returns an honest fallback instead of fabricated results.
Limits are set from measured traffic: across 419 agent_turn spans, the peak was 3 iterations and the longest turn was 31.5 seconds.
Four tools (flights, hotels, weather, itinerary), with limit breaches recorded on trace spans.

projects.name: Process Reward Model RL Environment
projects.description: An RL environment in which an LLM agent trains a Process Reward Model end-to-end. The model is graded against an Outcome Reward Model baseline and a PRM800K-style reference on a held-out MATH slice.
highlights: The judge runs seven gates, including step-localization F1, and scores a submission only when every hard gate passes.
Four example submissions are each engineered to trip a specific gate, and an end-to-end test asserts each one does.
The real PRM scores 0.770 in the demo, while the reward-hacking submissions score 0.000.

projects.name: JobPilot
projects.description: A local-first job-hunting assistant that discovers jobs, parses descriptions with spaCy, scores resume fit transparently and drafts tailored resumes and outreach. It never auto-applies or auto-sends.
highlights: Uses a transparent 7-component estimated match score: keyword match 30%, semantic similarity 20%, skills and bullet alignment 15% each.
Job discovery honors robots.txt with rate limiting, and every outreach draft requires manual review.
A Chrome extension sends public job pages to the local backend, and results export as DOCX/TXT packets.

projects.name: hierforecast
projects.description: Hierarchically reconciled energy demand forecasts using MinT shrinkage reconciliation, scored on pinball loss. Regional forecasts sum exactly to the national figure and the upper tail stays accurate.
highlights: MinT's p95 pinball loss is 14.3% lower than bottom-up (8.6-16.5% across seeds 1-6).
Independent forecasts disagreed by up to 612 MW; after reconciliation the gap is float round-off.
National RMSE is 456.4 MW versus 894.7 MW for the seasonal-naive baseline.

projects.name: modelcanary
projects.description: Progressive delivery for ML models: a FastAPI gateway serves ONNX models in shadow and then canary. Sequential tests decide automatic promotion or rollback.
highlights: Moves from a shadow stage to canary stages (e.g. 10% then 50%) with sticky salted-hash routing.
Wald SPRT and always-valid confidence sequences keep error guarantees no matter how often results are checked.
A SHA-256 hash-chained audit log detects edits, deletions and reordering.

projects.name: dagcache
projects.description: A content-addressed, parallel pipeline runner for reproducible ML workflows. It hashes code, params and data, explains why a stage is stale and traces artifact lineage.
highlights: SHA-256 cache keys cover code, params, input content and env vars, and AST normalization ignores comments.
Independent stages run in parallel, with local or S3 caches and push/pull sharing.
About 4,600 lines of typed Python with 165 tests under mypy --strict.

projects.name: replayagent
projects.description: A single-node, Temporal-style durable execution runtime for LLM agents. Event-sourced SQLite history and deterministic replay let a workflow resume after a crash without re-running finished steps.
highlights: Every state change is one lease-fenced SQLite transaction (WAL, synchronous=FULL).
A determinism checker compares re-issued commands by SHA-256 of their arguments.
Zero runtime dependencies, with crash injection at every gap between transactions.

projects.name: picklescope
projects.description: A static scanner for ML model files that inspects pickle, PyTorch, Keras, safetensors, GGUF and ONNX without deserializing them. It reports findings as text, JSON or SARIF.
highlights: Replays the unpickler's stack machine over abstract values to see every import without running any code.
Checks every import against an allow-list policy, with format-specific checks for documented attacks.
Zero runtime dependencies, with SARIF 2.1.0 output for CI.

projects.name: squatwatch
projects.description: An offline detector for typosquats, dependency-confusion exposure and risky install hooks in npm and PyPI dependencies. It outputs SARIF for CI.
highlights: Compares names against a snapshot of about 12,000 top PyPI projects and 14,000 high-impact npm packages.
Detects typosquats through Damerau-Levenshtein edits, keyboard adjacency, homoglyphs and scope tricks.
Reviews setup.py, .pth files and npm lifecycle scripts statically, without executing anything.
